easy.def: A tool you use to talk to people far away.

more.def: A device that lets you talk to people who are far away.
examples: I called my grandmother on the phone.
The phone rang, and my dad answered it.
She used her phone to take a picture of the rainbow.

easy.def: A picture taken with a camera.

more.def: A picture made with a camera, either printed or kept on a device.
examples: I took a photo of the sunset.
Grandma has a photo of me on the wall.
The photo shows our whole family.
